data.context: In the 2025 analytic note *Evaluating Trade Marks as a Leading Economic Indicator of the Australian Business Cycle*, the section on filing trends and recessions describes Australian trade mark application fluctuations during the early 1990s recession, the 2008 Global Financial Crisis and the Covid-19 pandemic, including the 2020–2021 filing boom. Figure 1 shows quarterly application volumes from Q1 1970 to Q2 2023.
